tasks.short: Estimate ingredient quantities and supply costs

steps.what: Check covers, recipe yields, stock, pack sizes and current supplier prices
Calculate required quantities, purchase packs and estimated supply costs
Check units, substitutions and uncertainty and finish the estimate

tasks.design: Test native recipe and purchasing calculations in the kitchen recipe-and-stock category {OTHER} before replacing the {SPREADSHEET}. Calculate covers times recipe quantities, subtract usable stock, round to supplier packs and apply checked prices; the chef retains input verification, exceptions and the final estimate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recipe yields, stock units and supplier pack prices often do not line up.
tasks.enabler_now: Native recipe costing can perform repeated arithmetic after the chef resolves the units.
tasks.still_hard: Waste allowance, uncertain covers, substitutions and stale supplier prices.
tasks.human_edge: Judge usable stock and realistic demand rather than accepting a calculated quantity blindly.
tasks.altitude: More attention to supply assumptions and less arithmetic; no additional buying authority.

evidence.claim: Apicbase rolls ingredient prices into recipe and portion costs and supports connected supplier price changes; this supports costing capability, not a local saving percentage.

assumptions: Focal boundary ends at a supply estimate, not an order or external send. The decomposition is provisional, not measured.

Planning supplies date, menu and expected covers; chef-maintained recipes supply ingredient, quantity, unit and yield; stores supplies usable quantity and unit; purchasing supplies pack quantity, price, currency and effective date. The chef checks and manually captures missing fields in s1. Incompatible units are corrected in s3 or calculated manually there, not inferred automatically.

{OTHER} is the existing kitchen recipe-and-stock system. Test native scaling, pack rounding and costing first. s2 is today's human calculation work, not existing automatic runtime; if calculations already run natively there is no corresponding saving.
The final estimate's ordinary internal save is included in s3, fully retained and ungated. Actual purchasing belongs to its own approval and order-send workflow.
unknowns: Availability and freshness of stock and supplier fields
research_questions: Can a sample estimate reconcile recipe units, usable stock and supplier packs without extra data capture?

already_counted.description: Input repair and final estimate checks remain in s1 and s3.

incremental.description: Chef maintains unit mappings and checks recipe calculation rules after changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; 35 calculation hours removed less 2 upkeep gives 33 net. Cautious case: mixed pack units and variable yields require manual calculation for most ingredients, leaving only 8 hours of supported arithmetic removed and 6 net; capture and correction stay counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate food-operation planning, budgets and purchasing

steps.what: Review kitchen plans, budget position and purchasing commitments
Resolve kitchen priorities, budget trade-offs and purchasing responsibilities with colleagues
Write the existing food-operation budget and action note
Check the final action note, owners, amounts and recipient group
outputs: final checked action note and recipients

steps.what: Send the checked action note to kitchen and purchasing colleagues
inputs: final checked action note and recipients

tasks.design: Use the existing {DOCS} budget-action template to avoid recreating headings and action-owner columns. The chef reviews source figures, negotiates priorities, writes the decisions and checks the final note before its separate internal send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different kitchens have competing constraints that a report cannot settle.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates remove layout work without deciding budgets or inventing meeting decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling service requirements with staffing, spend limits and delivery risk.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate workable commitments across kitchens and purchasing.
tasks.altitude: A little less note layout; the same coordination authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an existing budget-action document can use a fixed headings and owner-column template while retaining decision writing and checking.

assumptions: This branch includes the existing action note used by kitchen and purchasing colleagues, not an invented meeting log. Confirm that artefact and its actual readership; shares are hypotheses.

Kitchen leads provide their plans; finance provides budget period, actuals and commitments; purchasing provides open orders. s1 reads originals and resolves missing data manually. s2 produces decisions; s3 writes them, so no unpriced transcription or structured meeting output is assumed.
Test native {DOCS} templates. Only fixed headings and owner-column layout, estimated at 15% of s3, are removed; all substantive wording and ordinary saving remain.

The completed version and exact internal recipients are checked in s4 before s5; edits void approval. This coordination note does not approve supplier orders or budget activation; actual commitments need separate authorised steps and labour.
unknowns: Whether the action note exists today and who reads it
research_questions: Does a native template remove real repeated layout work from the existing coordination note?

already_counted.description: Source review, negotiation, note wording and final checks remain.

incremental.description: Chef updates action-note headings when reporting requirements change.

approvals.approved_version: s4 completed action note with checked amounts, owners and exact recipient group; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; 19*0.15=2.85 layout hours removed less 0.5 upkeep gives 2.35 net. Cautious case: a new kitchen requires bespoke action columns, leaving only 0.8 hours of reusable headings and 0.3 net. No negotiation or ordinary save saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Cost recipes and assign menu prices

steps.what: Check recipe quantities, ingredient prices, labour assumptions and overhead basis
Calculate portion food, labour and overhead costs and margin options
Judge positioning, demand and affordability and choose menu prices
Write and check the final menu price recommendation

tasks.design: Configure native portion-cost and margin calculations in the recipe-costing category {OTHER}, including a chef-checked labour and overhead allocation. Keep input repair, commercial price judgement and the final recommendation with the chef; menu publication or till activation requires its own later authorised workflow.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ingredient units and yield losses can make a plausible portion cost wrong.
tasks.enabler_now: Native recipe costing handles repeated arithmetic once its inputs and allocation rules are checked.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a price guests will accept and avoiding misleading overhead allocations.
tasks.human_edge: Balance culinary positioning, portion value and demand.
tasks.altitude: Review cost drivers and price choices rather than recompute each option.

evidence.claim: Apicbase provides ingredient-to-portion costing and labour-inclusive prime costs; it supports the arithmetic capability, not automatic commercial price judgement.

assumptions: Focal boundary is analysing recipes and assigning recommended prices; it ends at the existing price recommendation, not live publication. Shares are provisional.

Chef-maintained recipes supply ingredient quantity, unit, yield and portion count; purchasing supplies price/pack/effective date; finance supplies hourly labour rate and agreed overhead basis; the chef supplies preparation minutes. s1 checks and manually enters missing values; s3-s4 retain reconciliation and manual fallback for invalid mappings.

{OTHER} is the kitchen recipe-costing system. Test its native labour, yield and overhead fields before custom code. s2 must represent actual manual calculations today; existing formula runtime earns no saving.

The recommendation's ordinary author save is fully retained in s4 and needs no self-approval gate. If this chef also activates public menu prices, add the final-version approval and separate activation with their real time. Count shared recipe input maintenance once with task 11136.
research_questions: Can the native costing module reproduce a checked portion cost including yield, labour and overhead?

already_counted.description: Input repair, commercial judgement and final price checking remain.

incremental.description: Chef validates labour and overhead calculation rules after policy changes; common ingredient maintenance counted only once.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; 30 arithmetic hours removed less 1.5 upkeep gives 28.5 net. Cautious case: inconsistent recipe yields and nonstandard labour allocation leave most costs manual, with only 5 hours of supported calculations removed and 3.5 net. No price-choice or same-system save benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and supervise cooking across multiple kitchens

steps.what: Review kitchen menus, service volumes, staffing and equipment constraints
Write the existing kitchen production plan and sequencing instructions
Check final kitchen plan, timings, responsibilities and destination kitchens
outputs: final checked kitchen plan and destinations

steps.what: Issue the checked production plan to the destination kitchens
inputs: final checked kitchen plan and destinations

steps.what: Direct kitchen leads and resolve preparation and cooking conflicts
Supervise preparation and cooking and correct emerging quality or timing problems

tasks.design: Use the existing {DOCS} multi-kitchen plan layout for kitchen headings and service-time columns, leaving sequencing and staffing decisions with the chef. Check and issue the final plan separately, then retain live direction and supervision; {OTHER} denotes the existing kitchen planning system used for source volumes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cross-kitchen timing depends on equipment, skill and changing service conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: A native plan layout removes repeated formatting without scheduling people automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to late deliveries, skill shortages and food-quality problems.
tasks.human_edge: Prioritise across kitchens while understanding the actual food and team capability.
tasks.altitude: Less plan formatting, with the same supervision and food-safety responsibilities.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed kitchen-plan headings and service-time columns can be reused; physical supervision and sequence judgement remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes the actual written production plan used by kitchen leads plus direction and supervision. Validate this artefact and provisional shares, rather than inventing a post-service log.

Kitchen leads supply menu, service date, covers, staff availability and equipment constraints; s1 reads and clarifies them manually. s2 creates the sequencing and responsibility text; no free structured decisions or meeting recording is assumed.
Test native {DOCS} layout reuse first. Only kitchen heading and service-column formatting, 12% of s2, is removed. All sequencing, correction and same-system saving remain.

s3 checks the completed version and destinations before s4 issues it; edits void approval. Spoken clarification is retained in s5. Kitchen leads' own preparation labour lies outside this focal denominator and earns no saving.
unknowns: Existing production-plan format and actual readers
Actual time spent planning versus walking kitchens
research_questions: Does the standard plan layout remove formatting while retaining all kitchen-specific constraints?

already_counted.description: Source clarification, plan decisions, final check, direction and supervision remain.

incremental.description: Chef updates layout when kitchen or service structures change.

approvals.approved_version: s3 final kitchen production plan with checked timings, responsibilities and exact destination kitchens; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; 15*0.12=1.8 formatting hours removed less 0.4 upkeep gives 1.4 net. Cautious case: a temporary kitchen needs custom sequencing columns, leaving 0.6 reusable-heading hours and 0.2 net. Direction, supervision and issue time remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Recipe arithmetic moves into checked native calculations; the chef retains culinary, commercial and cross-kitchen decisions.
reach: Food-service cost controller: portion-cost and margin comparison with allocation training.
role.ambitious_version: Compare a limited set of checked portion-margin options before choosing menu prices, without automatic publication.
